description: A PostHog error tracking suppression rule: incoming exceptions that match a property filter are dropped (optionally sampled) before they create or update issues.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the rule belongs to.

Filters.description: JSON (use Fn::ToJsonString). Property-group filter that defines which incoming error events are suppressed, e.g. {"type": "AND", "values": [{"key": "$exception_values", "type": "event", "operator": "icontains", "value": "ResizeObserver loop"}]}. Omit it (or pass an empty values array) for a match-all rule.

SamplingRate.description: Probability that a matching event is dropped: 1.0 drops every match (default), 0.0 drops none, 0.5 drops half.

OrderKey.description: Evaluation priority among suppression rules; lower is evaluated first.
